Subject: Hosted API baseline — pilot sizing and minimums

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're finalizing budget for a Q4 pilot and need a clear picture of pricing options for your hosted API before procurement can sign off. A few specifics: 

- Expected traffic for a 30–60 day pilot: ~100k generated tokens / month and 20k embedding units.
- We currently do not want Dedicated capacity — hosted only.
- Is there a minimum monthly spend or a required commit for a short pilot?
- If there is a minimum, can we structure it as a refundable/credit-backed pilot?
- How are overages handled (per-token vs tiered overage rates)?

Can you share your latest public rate card and any pilot-friendly packaging you offer? If possible, include typical timelines to provision trial keys and a sample SOW/PO flow.

Appreciate it — procurement needs this by end of next week.

Best,
Leah Park
Procurement Lead
AvaMetrics

Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline — pilot sizing and minimums

Leah — thanks, this is helpful context. Quick summary of options that map to your use case (hosted-only, pilot-size traffic):

1) Zero-commit pilot (recommended first step)
   - Free trial credits (up to $5k) + 14-day active evaluation keys
   - Limits on concurrency and throughput; no SLA

2) Pilot-friendly Starter Pack (best for procurement workflows)
   - $10k prepaid credit applied to usage over 30 days
   - 10% introductory discount on published token rates for the pilot duration
   - Overages billed at published rates beyond prepaid credit; we can cap monthly overage at 50% above prepaid for predictability

3) Minimum monthly commit tiers (for teams ready to commit)
   - Tier A: $25k/month commit — 15% discount
   - Tier B: $50k/month commit — 25% discount + phone support
   - All tiers include 12-month minimum term unless otherwise negotiated (but we can do shorter pilot-specific terms)

Overage handling: by default we bill per-token at published rates after credits. For pilot packs we can gate overages and send alerts; for committed tiers we invoice monthly with usage reconciliation. Cancellation: pilot packs are refundable as credits if unused; committed tiers typically have a 30–60 day notice depending on contract.

I'm attaching the current rate card (pdf) and a short SOW template for pilots. If procurement prefers a refundable PO rather than a credit, we can accommodate that as a one-off.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow to align on pilot mechanics and the SOW? I can loop in Sales Ops to get DocuSign ready.

Thanks,

Thanks Karthik — that calms some concerns. A couple follow-ups from procurement and legal: 

- Flex on the $10k prepaid: can this be split across two months if the pilot runs longer?
- If we hit overage, how fast will we be notified and can we pause usage programmatically to avoid surprise bills?
- Refundable PO vs credit: procurement prefers a refundable PO that gets released as we hit usage thresholds. Any internal policy constraints?
- Data residency/retention: we are GTMing in EU as well — what controls do you offer for logs and retention for hosted customers?
- Sample SOW: can you include acceptance criteria for the pilot (latency SLO, token quality checks, success metrics)?

If we can get a short SOW and the pilot pack terms (refund PO option + split prepaid), procurement is likely to greenlight. Could you also provide two customer references that used the pilot pack?

Best,
Leah

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Leah's questions. My read: Avametrics is a strategic mid-market opportunity (marketing analytics) and has EU expansion next year. Recommend we offer a pilot concession to remove procurement friction. Proposed offer to present: 

- Pilot Pack: $10k prepaid, split option — allow split into two monthly credits (e.g., $6k + $4k) if pilot spans 45–60 days.
- Refundable PO: allow a refundable PO with 30% holdback release upon successful acceptance criteria met (acceptance criteria to be defined by Sales / Solutions).
- Overages: notify at 75% and 90% of prepaid; auto-pause available if enabled by customer; default is to bill up to a 50% cap over prepaid unless customer opts out.
- Data/Retention: standard hosted controls — configurable log retention (30/90/365 days), option for log-only retention in EU region (masking PII on request); list exact security artifacts in SOW.
- Discount: 10% pilot discount and a one-time onboarding credit (professional services) of $3k.

Marissa, please prepare a short SOW with acceptance criteria (latency under 350ms 95th pct for gen calls, embeddings throughput 500 reqs/min baseline, quality checks using provided seed prompts). Karthik, propose we offer two references (one analytics customer, one mid-market) — can you source?

-Aditya

Redwood Inference
